title: Rectangular plate
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of [0.4878, 0.0, 0.0]. On the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a single loop. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.2622, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.2622, 0.0) to (0.2622, 0.0983), followed by the third line from (0.2622, 0.0983) to (0.0, 0.0983), and finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0983) back to the origin. Apply a scale factor of 0.2622 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.4878, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0131 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body using the extruded sketch. The resulting rectangular plate has a length of 0.2622020785432185 units, a width of 0.09832577945370694 units, and a height of 0.013110103927160926 units. The plate features rounded edges and a flat surface.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.2622, 0).lineTo(0.2622, 0.0983).lineTo(0, 0.0983).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.0131)

# Translate the extruded shape
translated = extruded.translate((0.4878, 0, 0))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = translated
